capabilities: Color @annotations in code fences and notes
Color HTML comments in note bodies and html/xml fences
Configure which fence languages are highlighted
Toggle highlighting separately for reading and editing views
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not lint or process Java annotations; it only changes their display colors.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0+ for the declarative settings API; pending community plugin approval at the time of writing.
problem: Obsidian's default code block highlighting gives JVM annotations and comments no distinct, user-configurable colors.
summary: Syntax highlighter that colors JVM annotations (@Override, @Autowired) and comments in code blocks and notes, in both editing and reading views.
